description: This file defines the 'Translation' class within the 'Opencart\Admin\Model\Design' namespace. It contains methods for managing translation entries, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving translation data from the database.

classes.name: Translation
classes.description: Model class for handling translation data within the admin design namespace.

methods.name: addTranslation
methods.description: Inserts a new translation record into the database using provided data.

methods.name: editTranslation
methods.description: Updates an existing translation record identified by translation_id.

methods.name: deleteTranslation
methods.description: Deletes a translation record based on the translation_id.

methods.name: deleteTranslationsByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all translation records associated with a specific store ID.

methods.name: deleteTranslationsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all translation records associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getTranslation
methods.description: Retrieves a single translation record by translation_id.

methods.name: getTranslations
methods.description: Retrieves a list of translations with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalTranslations
methods.description: Returns the total count of translation records.
